title: Remaining Gaps Register — Blocking vs Non-Blocking for Framework v2 Permanent Adoption
type: Read-Only Adoption Certification — No Content Modifications
authority: S813 Executive Decision (5 conditions for full adoption)

categorization_key.BLOCKING: Must be resolved before Framework v2 transitions from Conditional to Full Adoption
categorization_key.HIGH_PRIORITY: Should be resolved in next 5 sessions; impacts operational quality but does not block adoption
categorization_key.MEDIUM_PRIORITY: Deferred to P2/P3; infrastructure exists, enhancement only
categorization_key.LOW_PRIORITY: Deferred to P3+; cosmetic, optimization, or forward-looking

items.description: Governance Guard Rule 6 — DL-026 BLOCK enforcement on non-CC distractor slots
items.current_state: Rule 2 blocks DL-008 (CC slot). Rule 6 does not yet block DL-026 (non-CC slots). 39 Domain F certified items have empty distractor EW slots.
items.impact: Blocks new certifications of items with empty distractor slots. Required for full adoption per S813.
items.remediation: Add enforcement check: all non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots must be non-empty before certification. Mirror existing Rule 2 pattern.

items.description: Pipeline artifact reuse between scan orchestrator, readiness scorer, and certification candidate engine
items.current_state: Each engine re-computes from source. No shared scan artifact consumption. 40-item BLOCKED divergence between tools. Artifact reuse = 0 downstream consumers in S812.
items.impact: Redundant re-computation. Routing divergence (242 vs 282 BLOCKED). Blocks efficient multi-wave pipeline.
items.remediation: Connect scan orchestrator output → readiness scorer input → candidate engine input. Standardize artifact schema for consumption contract.

items.description: Remediate 39 Domain F certified DL-026 items (~117 empty EW fields)
items.current_state: 39 items in learner pool with empty distractor ExplanationWrong slots. Learners see no feedback on wrong answers for these items.
items.impact: Educational quality degradation in learner pool. Blocks full adoption per S813.
items.remediation: Author choice-specific distractor explanations for ~117 empty non-CC EW slots. Batch into ≤30 items per governance guard Rule 5.

items.description: Log DL-035 (39 Domain F DL-026-on-Certified) and DL-036 (40-item routing divergence) to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md
items.effort: Low (1 session — this session or S815)
items.current_state: Not yet entered in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md. Per AGENTS.md §12: findings discovered in session must be logged before session close.
items.impact: Governance compliance — AGENTS.md §12 requires findings to be logged. Blocks full adoption per S813.
items.remediation: Add DL-035 and DL-036 entries to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md with full description, QID lists, and status.

items.description: Remediation queue auto-dispatch from defect manifest
items.current_state: S852 defect manifest has 264 entries. Work queue has 5 lanes. But no automated dispatch from manifest to remediation lane.
items.impact: Manual orchestration needed to convert defect manifest entries into remediation session packages. Blocks full adoption per S813.
items.remediation: Feed S852 defect manifest into automated remediation queue for batch dispatch (≤30 items per Rule 5). Connect to S250.3 session generator.

delta_review_gaps.label: Delta Review — Pending Second Certification Wave

items.description: Delta review skip rate not measured — requires re-certification of previously certified items
items.current_state: Delta ledger is 100% deterministic. All 2,540 items hashed. But zero operational delta comparisons exist — all items are NO_CHANGE vs baseline because no re-certification events have occurred.
items.impact: The projected 2.0-2.5× delta review multiplier is unproven. P3 target (3.8×) depends on delta review being activated.
items.resolution: Execute a re-certification wave on a set of already-Certified items. Measure skip rate, re-review reduction. First measurable at S811→S812 delta comparison.

items.description: Delta review inheritance rules (IR-001 through IR-005) not operationally exercised
items.current_state: All 5 rules validated as logically sound (S352 Board F). Not yet tested with real changed-content scenarios.
items.impact: Risk of undiscovered edge cases when content actually changes between certifications.
items.resolution: Exercise all 5 inheritance rules with real content changes in second certification wave.

board_consolidation_gaps.label: Board Consolidation — Pending Adoption in Certification Sessions

items.description: v2 5-board model not yet adopted by certification execution sessions
items.current_state: 5-board model operational in verification sessions (S811-S813: Registry, Quality, Governance, Certification, Throughput). Not yet adopted by certification sessions. S853 used batch script, not board model.
items.impact: P3 throughput target (3.8×) depends on 1.3-1.4× board consolidation multiplier. Agent reduction of 8→5 boards (37.5%) unrealized in certification workflow.
items.resolution: Adopt 5-board model as the standard for certification sessions. Phase in with next certification wave.

certified_pool_defects.label: Certified Pool Defects — Known Issues in Learner Pool

items.description: DL-021: 95 Pack E Section C Certified items with absent distractor ExplanationWrong slots
items.current_state: Per CURRENT_BASELINES.md: 95 Certified items with absent distractor EW slots. Active learner-pool exposure — degraded educational feedback.
items.impact: Learners receive no distractor explanation for wrong answers on these 95 items.
items.resolution: Author EW distractor explanations for all 95 items. Batch into ≤30 per Rule 5.

items.description: DL-016: Metadata-block Choice A-D +1 offset on 58 Pack A Section E Certified items + likely Pack C/D
items.effort: High (5+ sessions, requires systematic per-item CC verification)
items.current_state: ExplanationWrong fields describe wrong item's distractors due to metadata-content offset. Severity HIGH per DEFECT_LIBRARY.md.
items.impact: Distractor explanations misaligned — learners may see explanation for neighbor item's choices, not their own.
items.resolution: Per-item audit: verify all EW fields against content-block Choices (not metadata-block ChoiceA-D). Reconcile offset.

items.description: 39 Domain F DL-026 items — empty non-CC distractor EW slots on Certified items
items.note: This gap was previously unknown. Discovered during S812 repeatability verification.

items.description: Governance Guard Rule 6 (DL-026 BLOCK) not yet deployed
Policy drift detector detects 420 combined critical findings on Packs C/D — findings not yet resolved
items.current_state: S750 policy_drift_detector.js identified 420 critical findings (metadata drift, DL-013 residual, DL-026 gaps). Findings are monitored but not remediated.
items.impact: Drift accumulates over certification cycles. Non-blocking for adoption but degrades content quality.
items.resolution: Scheduled remediation as part of certification waves — not a separate remediation program.

items.description: Governance event registry storage not integrated into Admin Portal
items.current_state: Event registry at scripts/output/governance_event_registry.json. CLI access only. No dashboard visualization.
items.resolution: Integration with May Administration Portal (P1 deliverable).

items.description: Work queue not regenerated from post-S853 live state
items.current_state: Queue from S250 initial run (2,540 items, 265 BLOCKED). Post-S853: 2,298 Certified, 242 remaining. Queue lanes stale.
items.resolution: Regenerate work queue from live pack state. Scheduled as part of next certification wave planning.

items.description: Content authoring remains manual — modernization gates validation, does not create content
items.current_state: All 242 remaining BLOCKED items need content authoring (EW fills, boilerplate removal, metadata correction). v2 pipeline validates/classifies but does not create content.
items.impact: Certification throughput is gated by human authoring speed, not pipeline capacity.
items.resolution: Design limitation — content authoring is inherently human (IMA standards, COSO alignment). Pipeline can be optimized for validation speed but not for authoring speed.

items.description: May Administration Portal P0 modules not implemented (Question Management, Recommendation Registry, Session Registry, Certification Console, Admin Auth)
items.current_state: Backend registries operational. CLI access only. No web UI. RBAC model specified but not implemented. S204 Board H specification complete.
items.impact: All registry access requires CLI. No non-technical user access. No student-facing interface.
items.resolution: Phased implementation: P0 at S830, P1 at S900, P2 at S910. Per S203 migration plan.

items.description: Student data feed not operational
items.current_state: Student→Challenge→Question traceability chain specified but requires student attempt data which does not yet exist.
items.resolution: Implement when May learner engine (may-core.js) produces structured attempt data feed.

items.description: Investigation Workbench UI not built
items.current_state: Specified in S204 Board G. 35 challenges in registry. All investigation workflows are manual review.

items.description: S812 pipeline throughput regression: 3,175/s (W1) → 2,024/s (W2), -36.3%
items.current_state: S812 reported +13.7% pipeline timing increase. Attributed to environment variance. 176,000× vs manual provides enormous overhead margin.
items.impact: Non-blocking — throughput is in seconds, not hours. 2,024/s is still ~40,000× faster than v1 manual review.
items.resolution: Monitor across S813+ waves. Investigate only if trend continues below 1,000/s.

items.description: Pack A hash drift from S805 baseline — pre-existing, not S317/S318/S808 attributable
items.current_state: Documented in SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md. Pack A SHA-256 drifted from S805 baseline but all content and certified count verified correct. OneDrive sync timestamp artifact suspected.
items.resolution: Re-baseline after next authorized Pack A modification. Non-urgent.

blocking_items: GAP-S813-C3: Remediate 39 Domain F DL-026 items
gap_summary.note: All 5 blocking gaps are the S813 Conditional Adoption conditions (C1-C5). No NEW blocking gaps were discovered in S354 analysis — all 5 were identified in S813 and are now cataloged with detailed remediation paths.

what_is_not_a_gap.label: Items Classified as 'NOT A GAP' — Design Limitations or P3+ Targets
items: Delta review data (unrealized because first certification wave): P3 target by design, not a gap
Board consolidation (adoption deferred to P3): P3 target by design, not a gap
Content authoring automation (gates validate, don't create content): Design limitation, not a gap
Admin Portal UI (not implemented): P1/P2 deliverable by design, not a gap
Full 3.8× multiplier (requires delta + boards): P3 target by design, not a P1 gap
Pack C Sections C-F not audited: Deferred to certification waves — queue identifies all items

verdict: REMAINING_GAPS_CATALOGED — 18 gaps identified across 7 categories. 5 blocking (all S813 conditions C1-C5). 4 high-priority (certified pool defects DL-021/DL-016 + delta review/board consolidation data). 6 medium-priority (infrastructure enhancements). 3 low-priority (cosmetic/optimization). No new blocking gaps discovered beyond S813. Framework v2 is adoptable with C1-C5 closure within 5 sessions.
